title: How is Cleopatra connected to Hello Kitty?
description:
A Baroque painting, Rome's first dynasty, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes, a golf selfie and a Yokohama reception connect Cleopatra to Hello Kitty.

Cleopatra → Julius Caesar → Nero → Saint Peter → Pope Francis → Donald Trump → Shinzo Abe → Hello Kitty

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
